newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AFC Cable Systems raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AFC Cable Systems raised.

text.p: Jefferies & Co Inc analyst David Rose Thursday raised his rating on shares of AFC Cable Systems Inc to accumulate from hold based on its ability to add value to its commodity products.
-- In a statement, Rose said the company's armored cable and modular wiring systems can help electrical contractors save over 30 percent on traditional home installations.
-- said the products are gaining increasing acceptance.
-- said new management has improved operations and helped push the gross margin up 360 basis points in 1996 over 1995.
-- Expects earnings growth of 20 pct in 1997.
